<Picture 2>：左子穆，male, an elder past fifty, tall lean and slightly stooped, seated with one leg crossed; long grey beard, sharp thin face, grey hair in a topknot under a dark blue cap, deep indigo brocade robe with a broad sash, silk shoes.
<Picture 3>：东宗男弟子，male, group representative, a young man in his twenties of average build; plain face, hair in a simple topknot, dark grey cotton uniform with an indigo collar band, cloth shoes; twenty-odd East-Branch disciples stand shoulder to shoulder behind their master.
<Picture 4>：剑湖宫练武厅, a long rectangular hall of dark timber and grey stone whose core landmark is a raised square practice floor inlaid with a pale granite circle; a small brass oil lamp on a side table fixes the scale; packed earth floor, four rows of black lacquered pillars under a beam roof, two high chairs set apart on the east side, brocade stools along the west wall, far doors opening onto misted stone steps and old pines; overcast daylight through south lattice windows, warm lamp cores, hard shadow, cool slate palette, film grain, classical realist wuxia rendering

detailed_description:
This shot runs 13 seconds. <Picture 1> answers with her chin up and her voice flat, granting the young disciple his skill and then turning the talk to the jade wall, asking what five years of study there has produced; she is still in the lower chair, now square to <Picture 2>, one hand lifted off her knee while he half turns away. The window band has slid onto the armrests, one side of her face lit hard and the other black, the lamp bead warm at the edge of frame; cold, watchful air.

[Shot 1] A medium shot from the east windows frames <Picture 1> in the left middle ground facing almost to camera, <Picture 2>'s shoulder and beard filling the right foreground in soft blur.

[Shot 2] the camera cuts to a close shot on her mouth as she speaks, the words clipped and fast, says: <d>[Chinese]左师兄果然调教得好徒儿</d>

[Shot 3] the shot changes to a close shot on <Picture 2>'s hand stopping dead on his beard mid-stroke.

[Shot 4] the camera dynamically follows her shoulders as she leans a fraction forward, eyes fixed on him, says: <d>[Chinese]但不知左师兄对「无量玉壁」的钻研，这五年来可已大有心得么</d>

[Shot 5] the shot transitions to a medium shot of the East rank behind <Picture 2>: two <Picture 3> trading a glance, the pale circle and the planted 青钢剑 small between their shoulders.

overall_soundscape:
Room tone with a light draft and a far teacup clinking as the bed, breath drawn in through a nose, a silk sleeve rustling as <Picture 1> leans forward; close and dry, level under the voice.
